chat.hint_team: {name} picks who on the team works on it ({n} people), then writes the answer. Each agent is one model call.
chat.hint_brain: Answers from your notes, repos and memory, with sources.
chat.hint_member: {name} answers from your notes and repos. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
chat.suggest_brain_1: What did I work on this week?
chat.suggest_brain_2: What is still open in my TODOs?
chat.suggest_lead_1: What should the team focus on this week?
chat.suggest_lead_2: Review the plan for our next launch
chat.suggest_lead_3: Where are we losing time or money?
chat.suggest_member_1: What would you fix first, from your side?
chat.suggest_member_2: What risks do you see right now?
chat.suggest_member_3: Give me a plan for next week in your area
chat.lead_splits: {name} splits your request across the team, you watch each agent work, and you get one answer back.
